themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with systems, and make decisions within a research context.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that aid developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles highlighting specific AI tools or platforms designed to assist in various stages of the research process.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discussions on how AI is used to automate or augment the process of testing user interfaces and experiences for usability.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Articles detailing AI applications for creating, distributing, and analyzing surveys.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content related to the creation and use of artificial user profiles or data for research and testing purposes.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Articles exploring AI's role in understanding user needs, behaviors, and preferences to inform design decisions.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools and techniques used to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Content on how AI is being used in the recruitment process, from job matching to candidate assessment and the impact on the workforce.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that directly compare the features, performance, or effectiveness of different AI research tools.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
